FN-NR1S28T-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 123
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/27/2026
House Bill 123 as introduced would decrease sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by
approximately $19,790 annually beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on information provided
by the entity, by exempting the Cook Museum of Natural Science from paying state sales and
use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the estimated
annual amounts shown, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on information provided by the
entity, if the respective local governments adopt an exemption from local sales and use taxes,
pursuant to this bill:
County Funds $4,950
Municipal Funds $19,790
Page 1

FN-NR1S28T-2
FISCAL NOTE

Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/29/2026
REVISED
House Bill 123 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education would decrease
sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by the estimated annual amounts listed below,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on information provided by the entities, by exempting the
Cook Museum of Natural Science and the McWane Science Center from paying state sales and
use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the estimated
annual amounts shown, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on information provided by the
entities, if the respective local governments adopt an exemption from local sales and use taxes,
pursuant to this bill:

Fund Total
